# Hex for Android

An unofficial Android port of [Hex](https://github.com/anomalyco/hex), the
local dictation app. A floating bubble records; Hex's own speech engine
transcribes on your phone; the text goes into whatever you're typing in.
Nothing you say leaves the phone.

- **Download:** the APK is on the [Releases](../../../releases) page.
- **Install, use and build:** see [`android/README.md`](../android/README.md).

This repository is a fork of [anomalyco/hex](https://github.com/anomalyco/hex).
Everything Android lives in `android/`; the rest is upstream Hex, whose own
README is [`README.md`](../README.md). This port isn't made or endorsed by
Hex's authors.
